# Yugal Doddamani - Portfolio

## Professional Summary
Multidisciplinary Designer & Technologist specializing in Dental CAD/CAM, Video Editing, Graphic Design, and Web Architecture. Based in India, available for collaborations.

## Core Services
- Dental Design & CAD (Exocad, CAM Milling, Zirconia)
- Video Editing & Production (Color Grading, Pacing)
- Graphic Design & Visual Systems (Design Tokens, Grid System)
- Web Design & Architecture (Astro SSG, PostgreSQL RLS)
